title: Number of Islands
description:
Given a 2D grid of size $n \times m$ consisting of '1's (land) and '0's (water), count the number of islands.

An island is a group of '1's connected horizontally or vertically (not diagonally). The grid is surrounded by water on all sides.
inputFormat:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$ ($1 \leq n, m \leq 500$) — the number of rows and columns.

Each of the next $n$ lines contains a string of $m$ characters, each being '0' or '1'.
outputFormat: Print a single integer — the number of islands.
constraints:
$1 \leq n, m \leq 500$
$n \times m \leq 250000$
Each cell is either '0' or '1'.
